sources.snippet:
The first major 2026 change came with Custom Agents. They were free during the beta, then began using paid Notion credits on May 4. Notion priced those credits at $10 per 1,000 credits.

That system changed again in October. Business and Enterprise seats now come with monthly Standard and Select credit allowances. Notion says the new setup began for new workspaces on October 19 and will reach existing workspaces on November 2.

# ‘Thank you Somalia’: Notion finally moves to notion\.com, and there's a Grateful Dead story behind it

After years of operating on a \.so domain, Notion is finally moving to Notion\.com\.

But the story behind the domain acquisition was not just about money\. It involved patience, relationship-building and an unexpected connection with the legendary rock band Grateful Dead\.

Notion’s co-founder Akshay Kothari shared the story behind the acquisition, saying the journey began in 2018 when he had just joined the company\. One of his first tasks, assigned by Notion founder Ivan Zhao, was to figure out how the company could acquire Notion\.com\.

# Australia leads on AI ROI, so why don't employees trust it?

**Australian businesses are ahead of the region when it comes to measuring what AI actually delivers. According to Notion's Global AI Transformation Study 2026, Australia tops Asia Pacific for tracking AI's measurable business impact at 76%, narrowly ahead of Singapore at 75% and well ahead of Japan at 55%.**

But that confidence at the top doesn't extend to the shop floor. Australia carries the region's widest internal confidence gap: 61% of decision-makers say they're highly confident in their organisation's AI capabilities, compared with just 26% of knowledge workers who say the same.
